pages.title: Simmer Everything
pages.text: The Farmer's Delight $(item)Cooking Pot$() does the heavy lifting for every soup, stew, and simmered dish in this chapter: set it over heat, fill the slots, wait for the bubbling.$(p)Pot recipes are a craft of their own and won't fit on these pages — look any dish up in the recipe viewer to see its exact ingredients. The best of the menu follows.
$(item)Dino Stew$() — dino meat, carrot, potato. The beef stew of a bolder food chain. Bowls come back when you're done; gratitude does not.
$(item)Whale Chowder$() — blubber, milk, potato, onion. Thick enough to stand a spoon in, warming enough to justify the whole voyage.
$(item)Shark Fin Soup$() — shark meat and onion, thickened with Triffid green goo. The goo is doing more work in this recipe than anyone wants to discuss.
$(item)Ink-Black Pasta$() — pasta, calamari, tomato, and a generous measure of the Kraken's own ink. Finally, a use for the hundred-odd ink sacs it left you.
$(item)Jellyfish Salad$() — irukandji, greens, radish. Chilled, crisp, and only mildly threatening once cooked.
$(item)Quinoa Bowl$() — Crystal Dimension quinoa with vegetables and greens. The single healthiest object in this cookbook. It will not be lonely for company.
